notes: Recomputes the orthogonal wavelet coefficients, dead-zone integer quantization, support, and midpoint reconstruction. The binary example stores a header, unsigned 16-bit indices, and signed 16-bit nonzero symbols; its measured length includes the header. It is an explicit support codec, not JPEG-2000. Zero is reconstructed as zero, and nonzero symbols as sign(q)(|q|+1/2)T.
